dedupe_keys.name: gadetræer street trees of the city of copenhagen open data dk

description: Gadetræer is the open dataset of street trees in the Municipality of Copenhagen, published by the city's Bydata team on the Open Data DK portal. It is offered in three forms: GeoJSON from the city's WFS map service, a CSV file of about 5.2 MB that is also queryable through the CKAN DataStore API, and a zipped shapefile. The metadata gives the update frequency as continuous, and questions go to the city's data e-mail address. The dataset is published under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, and access is free. Caveats: the page gives a one-line description only, so the attribute definitions (such as species, planting year or size) have to be read from the files, and the dataset covers street trees, not all urban trees. Coverage is the Municipality of Copenhagen. It supports climate adaptation and hazard exposure analysis, such as urban heat and cloudburst planning and storm damage to trees along roads and power lines; related records are the Zürich tree cadastre and the USFS urban forest inventory.
